fusions.name: Eats Anything
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds up to 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Headlong Crush
fusions.desc: The swarm butts forward in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Clinging Mass
fusions.desc: Your swarm locks onto you, raising your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Grazes on Thorns
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
